trace.label: find the station named in the question
trace.cypher:
CALL db.idx.fulltext.queryNodes('Station', $q) YIELD node, score
RETURN node.id AS id, node.name AS name, node.routes AS routes, score
ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 8

trace.label: teams that own or maintain it, and their people
trace.cypher:
MATCH (t:Team)-[rel:OWNS|MAINTAINS]->(n)
WHERE (n:Station AND n.id IN $stations) OR (n:Route AND n.id IN $routes)
OR (n:Route AND size($routes) = 0 AND n.id IN $stationRoutes)
OR ((n:Playbook OR n:Incident) AND n.id IN $ids)
WITH t, collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN type(rel) = 'MAINTAINS' THEN 'maintains the elevators at ' + n.name
WHEN hasLabels(n, ['Route']) THEN 'plans the ' + n.id
ELSE 'owns ' + coalesce(n.title, n.id) END) AS via
OPTIONAL MATCH (p:Person)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(t)
RETURN t.id AS team, t.name AS name, t.mission AS mission, t.ord AS ord, via[0] AS via,
collect(DISTINCT {id: p.id, name: p.name, role: p.role}) AS people
ORDER BY ord

trace.label: tickets about it, open first
trace.cypher:
MATCH (k:Ticket)
OPTIONAL MATCH (k)-[:MENTIONS]->(n) WHERE (n:Station AND n.id IN $stations) OR (n:Route AND n.id IN $routes AND size($stations) = 0)
WITH k, count(n) AS hits
WHERE hits > 0 OR k.id IN $ids
OPTIONAL MATCH (k)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(a:Person)
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(t:Team)
RETURN k.id AS id, k.title AS title, k.status AS status, a.name AS assignee, a.role AS role, t.name AS team
ORDER BY CASE k.status WHEN 'open' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, k.openedMs DESC
LIMIT 4

trace.label: who wrote, posted, filed or decided records about it
trace.cypher:
MATCH (p:Person)-[:AUTHORED|POSTED|FILED|DECIDED]->(x)-[:MENTIONS]->(n)
WHERE ((n:Station AND n.id IN $stations) OR (n:Route AND n.id IN $routes) OR (n:Incident AND n.id IN $ids)) AND p.id <> 'P-YOU'
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(t:Team)
RETURN p.name AS name, p.role AS role, t.name AS team, count(DISTINCT x) AS items, collect(DISTINCT x.id) AS ids

trace.label: who is assigned tickets about it
trace.cypher:
MATCH (x:Ticket)-[:MENTIONS]->(n) WHERE (n:Station AND n.id IN $stations) OR (n:Route AND n.id IN $routes) OR (n:Incident AND n.id IN $ids)
MATCH (x)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(p:Person)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(t:Team)
RETURN p.name AS name, p.role AS role, t.name AS team, count(DISTINCT x) AS items, collect(DISTINCT x.id) AS ids

trace.label: the sources, with who wrote them and when
trace.cypher:
UNWIND $ids AS sid
MATCH (x) WHERE x.id = sid AND (x:Document OR x:Ticket OR x:Message OR x:Decision OR x:Finding OR x:Playbook OR x:Plan)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p:Person)-[:AUTHORED|POSTED|FILED|DECIDED]->(x)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(t:Team)
OPTIONAL MATCH (ag:Agent)-[:WROTE]->(x)
OPTIONAL MATCH (x)-[:MENTIONS|ABOUT]->(m) WHERE m:Station OR m:Route
RETURN labels(x)[0] AS label, x.id AS id, coalesce(x.title, x.label) AS title, coalesce(x.text, x.rationale) AS text,
coalesce(p.name, ag.name, x.approvedBy) AS by, t.name AS team,
coalesce(x.decidedMs, x.openedMs, x.publishedMs, x.createdMs, x.atMs, x.validFromMs, x.lastUsedMs) AS atMs,
x.status AS status, x.validToMs AS validToMs,
collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN hasLabels(m, ['Route']) THEN m.id ELSE m.name END) AS about

trace.label: the elevators and escalators at the station
trace.cypher:
MATCH (e:Equipment {station: $station}) WHERE $kind = '' OR e.kind = $kind
RETURN e, e.id AS id ORDER BY id LIMIT 80

trace.label: their outages, current, planned and resolved
trace.cypher:
MATCH (o:Outage) WHERE o.equipment IN $ids AND ($history OR o.status <> 'resolved')
RETURN o, o.openedMs AS t ORDER BY t DESC

trace.label: the MTA's alternative routes for them
trace.cypher: MATCH (d:AltRoute)-[:FOR]->(e:Equipment) WHERE e.id IN $ids RETURN d

answers.question: Why do L tube bus bridges get 27% more buses?
answers.answer: “Divide every bus bridge estimate by the corridor's observed share of plan” was decided by Tunde Okafor, Bus bridge coordinator, on Jun 20, 2026 [1]. It generalizes the L tube rule to every corridor: with the last L tube bridge at 79% of plan, the controller adds 27% more buses than the raw estimate; on the A and C, at 93%, it adds 8%. It rests on Renee Alvarez's decision “Size L tube bus bridges on observed throughput” [2], Tunde Okafor's chat message [3] and finding F-0612-1 [4]. Finding F-0612-1 traces back to Renee Alvarez's after-action report [5], ticket BUS-0612-07 [6] and Tunde Okafor's chat message [3]. It changed “Bus bridge sizing procedure”. It is still in force.

trace.label: find the decision the question is about
trace.cypher:
MATCH (d:Decision)
WITH d, toLower(d.title + ' ' + d.rationale) AS hay
WITH d, size([w IN $terms WHERE hay CONTAINS w]) AS score
WHERE score > 0
RETURN d.id AS id, score ORDER BY score DESC, d.decidedMs DESC LIMIT 1

trace.label: the decision, who made it, and what it rests on
trace.cypher:
MATCH (d:Decision {id: $id})
OPTIONAL MATCH (p:Person)-[:DECIDED]->(d)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(t:Team)
OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:BASED_ON]->(b)
OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:CHANGED]->(c)
OPTIONAL MATCH (later:Decision)-[:BASED_ON]->(d)
RETURN d.id AS id, d.title AS title, d.rationale AS rationale, d.decidedMs AS decidedMs, d.status AS status,
d.liftedMs AS liftedMs, p.name AS by, p.role AS role, t.name AS team,
collect(DISTINCT b.id) AS basedOn, collect(DISTINCT coalesce(c.title, c.id)) AS changed, collect(DISTINCT later.id) AS later

trace.label: where the findings it rests on came from
trace.cypher:
MATCH (:Decision {id: $id})-[:BASED_ON]->(f:Finding)-[:SOURCED_FROM]->(s)
RETURN f.id AS finding, collect(DISTINCT s.id) AS sources

trace.label: the sources, with who wrote them and when
trace.cypher:
UNWIND $ids AS sid
MATCH (x) WHERE x.id = sid AND (x:Document OR x:Ticket OR x:Message OR x:Decision OR x:Finding OR x:Playbook OR x:Plan)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p:Person)-[:AUTHORED|POSTED|FILED|DECIDED]->(x)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(t:Team)
OPTIONAL MATCH (ag:Agent)-[:WROTE]->(x)
OPTIONAL MATCH (x)-[:MENTIONS|ABOUT]->(m) WHERE m:Station OR m:Route
RETURN labels(x)[0] AS label, x.id AS id, coalesce(x.title, x.label) AS title, coalesce(x.text, x.rationale) AS text,
coalesce(p.name, ag.name, x.approvedBy) AS by, t.name AS team,
coalesce(x.decidedMs, x.openedMs, x.publishedMs, x.createdMs, x.atMs, x.validFromMs, x.lastUsedMs) AS atMs,
x.status AS status, x.validToMs AS validToMs,
collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN hasLabels(m, ['Route']) THEN m.id ELSE m.name END) AS about

answers.question: What is the MTA's alternative route when elevator EL293 is out?
answers.answer: Elevator EL293 at 1 Av (E 14 St and Avenue A (SW corner) to Canarsie-bound platform) is in service: the MTA's outage feed lists no current outage for it [1]. Then use elevators for Canarsie-bound L service. If you are on the platform: Take a Canarsie-bound L to Bedford Av. Then transfer across the platform to an 8 Av-bound L to 1 Av.” [3]

steps.summary: 5 changes in the last 7 days: DEC-1014-SF decided, DOC-NOTICE-MW written, MSG-1014-1 posted, F-ELEV-2 learned.

trace.label: changes in the last 7 days
trace.cypher:
MATCH (x) WHERE x:Finding OR x:Ticket OR x:Decision OR x:Document OR x:Message OR x:Plan
UNWIND [['learned', x.validFromMs], ['closed', x.validToMs], ['opened', x.openedMs], ['resolved', x.resolvedMs],
['decided', x.decidedMs], ['lifted', x.liftedMs], ['written', x.createdMs], ['posted', x.atMs],
['published', x.publishedMs]] AS e
WITH x, e[0] AS what, e[1] AS at
WHERE at IS NOT NULL AND at >= $since
RETURN x.id AS id, labels(x)[0] AS label, what, at
ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 12

trace.label: the sources, with who wrote them and when
trace.cypher:
UNWIND $ids AS sid
MATCH (x) WHERE x.id = sid AND (x:Document OR x:Ticket OR x:Message OR x:Decision OR x:Finding OR x:Playbook OR x:Plan)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p:Person)-[:AUTHORED|POSTED|FILED|DECIDED]->(x)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(t:Team)
OPTIONAL MATCH (ag:Agent)-[:WROTE]->(x)
OPTIONAL MATCH (x)-[:MENTIONS|ABOUT]->(m) WHERE m:Station OR m:Route
RETURN labels(x)[0] AS label, x.id AS id, coalesce(x.title, x.label) AS title, coalesce(x.text, x.rationale) AS text,
coalesce(p.name, ag.name, x.approvedBy) AS by, t.name AS team,
coalesce(x.decidedMs, x.openedMs, x.publishedMs, x.createdMs, x.atMs, x.validFromMs, x.lastUsedMs) AS atMs,
x.status AS status, x.validToMs AS validToMs,
collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN hasLabels(m, ['Route']) THEN m.id ELSE m.name END) AS about

answers.question: Is the elevator at Times Sq-42 St working?
answers.answer: The MTA lists 10 elevators at Times Sq-42 St/Port Authority Bus Terminal, maintained by Private Contractor (5) and NYCT (3) and Third-Party Contractor (2). Elevator EL290X at 42St/Port Authority-Bus Terminal (intermediate landing to mezzanine for A/C/E service in both directions) is out of service since Oct 28, 2024, 6:26 AM, reason: Repair . The MTA estimates it back in service Dec 31, 2026, 11:00 PM. The MTA's asset inventory says EL290X is maintained by Private Contractor . The MTA's alternative route: “If you are on the intermediate landing: Take elevator to street level and proceed down 8 Av to Port Authority Bus Terminal for access to subway. If you are on the A/C/E mezzanine: Contact a station agent to re-enter through the faregate and follow signs to exit via Port Authority Bus Terminal.”
